Alternatives to keratin treatment/Brazilian blowout to instantly fix frizzy hair?
Hi everyone, I made [this post](https://www.reddit.com/r/beauty/comments/lp5bvv/my_hair_wont_stop_being_frizzy_and_ive_tried/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share) and the majority of the comments said to get a keratin treatment or  Brazilian blowout but I cannot  afford this yet, i dont work at the moment. Nor can I afford any more products. I just want some techniques and instant fixes to my hair as I am currently going to school everyday with awful hair. I am trying to follow blowdrying tutorials with my leave in conditioner and all that, but my hair is still frizzy??? I am beyond frustrated and I really need some quick technique tips because its humiliating to go to school with extremely frizzy hair especially when you spend so much time researching and experimenting. Also I cant put my hair up because I look like an egg so advice is desperately needed thanks
